content: संस्थ {%a.%} .²1 Staying, abiding, lasting. .²2 Dwelling, being, existing, situated (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); जवेनात्मनि संस्थेन सोऽसौ पूर्ण इवार्णवः <ls>Rām. 7. 36. 27</ls>; शिष्टा क्रिया कस्यचिदात्मसंस्था <ls>M. 1. 16</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 60</ls>; निसर्गभिन्नास्पदमेकसंस्थम् <ls>R. 6. 29</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 16</ls>. .²3 Tame, domesticated. .²4 Fixed, stationary. .²5 Ended, perished, dead. .²6 Come to an end, completed. .²7 Manifested (व्यक्त). .{@-स्थः@} .²1 A dweller, an inhabitant. .²2 A neighbour, countryman. .²3 A spy.
